using Makie

function makeplot(x, mu, sigma)
    fig = Figure(size = (640, 400))
    ax = Axis(fig[1, 1], xlabel = "Time", ylabel = "Value", title = "Estimate")
    
    # Plot the semi-transparent blue band
    band!(ax, x, mu .- sigma, mu .+ sigma, color = (:blue, 0.3))
    
    # Plot the mean line
    lines!(ax, x, mu, color = :blue, label = "Mean")
    
    # Add legend
    axislegend(ax, position = :lt)
    
    return (fig, ax)
end

using Makie

function makeplot(x, mu, sigma)
    fig = Figure(size = (640, 400))
    ax = Axis(fig[1, 1], xlabel = "Time", ylabel = "Value", title = "Estimate")
    
    # Plot the semi-transparent blue band
    band!(ax, x, mu .- sigma, mu .+ sigma, color = (:blue, 0.3))
    
    # Plot the mean line
    lines!(ax, x, mu, color = :blue, label = "Mean")
    
    # Add legend
    axislegend(ax, position = :lt)
    
    return (fig, ax)
end
